answer: A workable design: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Link analysis on reused seeds marks the whole set. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, the bond burns and standing resets to zero. An identity earns only when its knoll recurs, its horizon survives audit, and a copper from an unlinked peer confirms it.
